blocks.arabic_text: قَارِئئٌ، فَقَدْ قِيْلَ، ثُمَّ اُمِرَ بِهِ فَسُحِبَ عَلي وَجْهِهِ حَتَّي اُلْقِيَ فِي النَّارِ، وَرَجُلٌ وَسَّعَ اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَاَعْطَاهُ مِنْ اَصْنَافِ الْمَالِ كُلِّهِ، فَاُتِيَ بِهِ فَعَرَّفَهُ نِعَمَهُ، فَعَرَفَهَا، قَالَ: فَمَا عَمِلْتَ فِيْهَا؟ قَالَ: مَا تَرَكْتُ مِنْ سَبِيْلٍ تُحِبُّ اَنْ يُنْفَقَ فِيْهَا اِلَّا اَنْفَقْتُ فِيْهَا لَكَ، قَالَ: كَذَبْتَ، وَلكِنَّكَ فَعَلْتَ لِيُقَالَ هُوَ جَوَادٌ، فَقَدْ قِيْلَ، ثُمَّ اُمِرَ بِهِ، فَسُحِبَ عَلي وَجْهِهِ، ثُمَّ اُلْقِيَ فِي النَّارِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم، باب من قاتل للرياء والسمعة استحق النار، رقم:٤٩٢٣
blocks.tamil_translation: “On the Day of Qiyamah, among the very first to receive a judgement against themselves is one who lost his life in the path of Allah. He will be brought before Allah Ta'ala; Allah Ta'ala will recount the blessings that were given to him, and he will acknowledge them.”“What did you do for these blessings?” Allah Ta'ala will ask. He will say, “I fought for Your pleasure and lost my life.” Allah Ta'ala will say, “You are lying; you fought so that people would call you brave, and so it has been said.” Then the judgement will be read out before him, and he will be dragged on his face and flung into Jahannam. The second man is one who acquired religious knowledge and also taught it to others, and who recited the Qur'an; he will be brought before Allah Ta'ala. Allah Ta'ala will recount the blessings that were given to him, and he will acknowledge them. Allah Ta'ala will ask him, “What work did you do for these blessings?” He will say, “For Your pleasure I acquired religious knowledge and also taught it to others, and for Your pleasure alone I recited the glorious Qur'an.” “You are lying! You acquired Ilm so that people would call you an Alim. So that people would call you a Qari, you recited the Qur'an
